text: Gate B limit B4 needs your call. 03-imports/PLAN.md line 46 says 'Stop and ask if: parser cannot enforce limits before inflation'. The Gate B probe (team-t012/lying-header-probe.log) shows a DOCX whose zip headers understate a 300 MiB entry passes the central-directory check and is rejected by jszip only AFTER inflating (about 100 MiB memory rise, no crash, no partial project). DELEGATION.md line 62 asked only for the central-directory check, which is implemented. Options: (a) accept B4 as a documented limit (current state, no change); (b) open a repair task to add a streaming byte cap during inflation (jszip's streaming API, no new package) so a lying header cannot inflate past the limit. Gate B passed with B4 disclosed; nothing is blocked while you decide.
resolution: Owner (via coordinator): (a) accept B4 as a documented limit: a lying zip header inflates before rejection (bounded memory cost, no partial project, no crash). No streaming cap task for the beta.
